exposure: painless delivery with new labor management
painless delivery with routine labor management
outcome: duration of first and second stages of labor
medical intervention during first stage of labor (artificial rupture of membranes, use of oxytocin)
visual analog scale (VAS) scores upon complete cervical dilation
finding: Painless delivery under the guidance of new concept of labor did not significantly influence maternal and neonatal outcomes, but was associated with a longer labor process, reduced medical interventions during delivery, decreased delivery pain, and increased natural delivery rate and maternal satisfaction.
